proposals.rationale: All three baseline first attempts failed only feature_chain despite matching the successful geometry. An explicit first-attempt review targets the repeated extra attempt. Prior structural guidance had mixed results, so improvement remains unproven.

edit.value: If feature_chain is the sole failed predicate and feedback confirms completed execution and valid geometry, preserve the dimensions and focus the retry on feature types, Body membership, profile links, predecessor links, and final tip. Treat the aggregate failure as insufficient to identify any particular broken relationship.

proposals.rationale: Helps retries distinguish structural failures from execution or geometry failures. Every baseline recovered without changing measured geometry. Earlier feedback experiments showed mixed results, so this is a targeted diagnostic hypothesis.

Tests whether additional reasoning alone reduces the consistent first-attempt structural failure. The prior unsupported experiment combined medium reasoning with added guidance, leaving its independent effect unknown. Retain only if fewer retries outweigh the added reasoning cost.
